title: Teacher Application Status
subtitle: Teacher features are unlocked after an administrator approves your teacher account.
loadFailed: Your application status could not be loaded.
refreshFailed: The status could not be refreshed. Please try again shortly.

pending.title: Your application is under review
pending.body: Your teacher registration was received and is being reviewed by an administrator. Until it is approved, exam authoring, study content, question transfer, bookings and the teacher dashboard are unavailable.
pending.hint: You will be notified once a decision is made; you can refresh the status on this page at any time.
pending.tutorProfileHint: If you applied as an independent tutor, you can prepare your tutor profile while you wait:

rejected.title: Your application was rejected
rejected.body: An administrator rejected your teacher account application. Teacher features remain unavailable for this account.
rejected.stepReview: Review the reason and prepare any missing or incorrect information.
rejected.stepContact: Contact your school administrator or the platform administrator to have your application reconsidered.
rejected.meanwhile: Meanwhile, you can keep using pages that do not require teacher features, such as settings.

approved.title: Your account is approved
approved.body: Your teacher account has been approved; all teacher features are now available.

noRecord.title: No teacher record found
noRecord.body: Your account does not have a completed teacher record. Complete the teacher registration to continue.
